**Key findings:**
- La Rochelle has **zero 2-star** Michelin restaurants in 2026
- The only 2-or-3-star option is **Christopher Coutanceau ⭐⭐⭐** (Plage de la Concurrence) — tasting menus €275–€340, Tue–Sat, sustainable seafood focus, book weeks to months ahead
- **La Yole de Chris** (same chef, same beach) offers a casual bistro alternative at ~€60 with a Michelin Green Star
- Nearest 2-star restaurants are all in Bordeaux, ~145 km away
